title: Belalı Bir Sevgilidir Ardımda Bıraktığım Şehir
author: Aslı Tunç
description: The City I Left Behind is a Lover Who Spreads Trouble brings together nine evocative stories set across Florence, Barcelona, Amsterdam, Istanbul, Paris, Rome, Dubai, and Lesbos, before concluding in a place beyond all maps. Blending romance, memory, loss, longing, and magical realism, the collection transforms each city into a living presence, at once a witness, a confidant, and a troublesome lover impossible to forget. Encounters that blur the boundaries between past and present, dream and reality, lead its characters through unfinished love affairs, buried secrets, unexpected reckonings, and moments of fleeting connection, revealing how deeply the places we leave behind continue to inhabit us.
original_title: Belalı Bir Sevgilidir Ardımda Bıraktığım Şehir
english_title: The City I Left Behind is a Lover Who Spreads Trouble
